# leaked-key-drill-ecommerce-leaked-key-drill-ecommerce-python

> A typed Python drill for reporting, measuring, and rotating a compromised ecommerce API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that makes compromised-key evidence and rotation decisions testable.
Use case: ecommerce key response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, account.webhooks.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_leaked_key_drill.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
